prompt.alinti: You hit your Claude Code limit mid-build. Then it compacts and forgets your work.
Here’s the thing. Somebody already fixed both.
9 repos from the last 30 days. Usage limits in your Mac notch. Compaction without the amnesia. Any agent on any model. One skill that ships your app live.
Install one, not nine. Pick this week’s problem.
